name: Job Search Agent
description: Analyzes your resume, scrapes job boards via Firecrawl, filters results, and delivers top matches to Telegram.

nodes.title: Collect Resume
nodes.task: Please paste your resume text or upload your resume file (PDF or DOCX). Also tell me your target job title and preferred location.

nodes.title: Parse Resume
nodes.task:
Analyze the resume provided. Extract:
1. Top 8 technical skills
2. Years of experience per domain
3. Target job title (from user input or inferred)
4. Seniority level (junior/mid/senior)
5. Preferred location

Output as structured text. End with:
SET_VAR: job_title = <extracted job title>
SET_VAR: location = <extracted location>

nodes.title: Filter & Rank Jobs
nodes.task:
Review the scraped job listings against the candidate's resume profile from earlier context.

Select the top 5 most relevant jobs. For each:
- Job Title
- Company
- Location
- Why it matches (2 sentences)
- Apply URL

If results are insufficient or irrelevant:
RETRY_PARENT: The scraped results lacked relevant listings. Try a broader search query.

nodes.title: Send Results
nodes.task:
🎯 Top Job Matches

{{output}}

---
Found via RAPR AI Job Search Agent
